language_label: Normalized IV-defined experiment with fixed-parameter profile and three exact roughness candidates.
sample_rows: First maturity T=0.5 only, twelve strikes; no inference for remaining three maturities

quote_conversion.option_type: synthetic normalized call defined by IV, irrespective of missing original call/put flag
quote_conversion.T_interpretation: Exact CSV decimal mathematical time; no inferred calendar expiry or day count
quote_conversion.IV_interpretation: Exact CSV decimal defines experiment; no inferred unrounded vendor quote
quote_conversion.price_mid_target: arithmetic mean of exact BS prices from bid-IV and ask-IV
quote_conversion.reported_mid_IV: preserved secondary diagnostic, never silently substituted for price-mid

profile_parameters.curve_rule: xi_star is never recomputed with candidate alpha; lambda_xi is not inserted into Riccati lambda_R
profile_parameters.published_parameter_origin: Jeng-Kilicman 2021 Table 1 G-Pade; rounded author fitted values used only to freeze an explicit profile, not estimated true parameters

objectives.weights: all w_i=1/12; nonnegative and sum to one
objectives.optimizer_scope: global over three exact candidates only
objectives.no_silent_replacement: Original author IV-RMSE and any first-maturity subset are distinct declared experiments

certification_outputs_required: point true-price enclosures for every required finite candidate including Riccati, exponent, quadrature and Fourier tail errors
each finite candidate objective interval [L_j,U_j] and finite global objective range [min L_j,min U_j]
finite near-optimal alpha/H set and finite smooth-class exclusion only when strict objective gap is actually certified
all data, arithmetic, parameter and solver budgets stated; no stored author model-IV vector used as a true-model witness

optional_second_contract_not_activated.warning: No optional continuous/2D inference transferred from finite result

real_market_metadata: missing actual F,D,dividends,cash prices,timestamp,calendar expiry/day count and IV inversion convention are not imputed
reuse_boundary: article CC BY 4.0 does not establish a repository/data license; preserve attribution and keep frozen raw inputs with provenance; redistribution license remains unverified
scope_change: Explicit finite-candidate first-maturity calibration; no continuous argmin/range/identification conclusion. Continuous contract preserved separately.
